- `email` (string, required): The email address for which the courses are to be retrieved.

The response will contain an array of course objects with the following properties:

- `id` (integer): The unique identifier of the course.
    
- `shortname` (string): The abbreviated name of the course.
    
- `fullname` (string): The full name of the course.

- `exception` (string): Details of any exceptions that occurred.
    
- `errorcode` (string): Error code, if applicable.
    
- `message` (string): Error message, if applicable.
    
- `debuginfo` (string): Additional debug information, if available.

request.description:
### POST Request to Create Course Module Resource

This endpoint allows you to create a new module resource for a specific course and section.

#### Request Body

- `email` (string, required): The user email address.
    
- `course_id` (string, required): The course id.
    
- `section_id` (string, required): The course section id. Use '0' for singleactivity course format.
    
- `file_name` (string, required): The file name.
    
- `file_url` (string, required): The file URL.
    

#### Response

The response will contain the following properties:

- `status` (boolean): Indicates the success status of the request.
    
- `organisation_id` (string): The organization id, if applicable.
    
- `module` (object): The details of the created module resource, including its id, name, and module type.
